title: Testing Strategy Selector
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners match four story-platform testing scenarios to unit, integration, system, or user acceptance testing.

learningObjectives: Select appropriate testing types (unit, integration, system, UAT) for different testing scenarios and objectives.
prerequisites: Story Testing Strategy and Story Quality Assurance sections of Chapter 15

keyQuestions: Select appropriate testing types (unit, integration, system, UAT) for different testing scenarios and objectives.
assessmentOpportunities: Correct testing type for all four scenarios.
Learner can explain why UAT is not optional.
